scope: Current tested single-camera simulation support motion and current-version stereo input-stale response. Does not establish free-flight safety, real D435i behavior, or a root cause for the historical normalized-cost crossing.

normal_motion_observations.qualification_note: The fixture RPC failure remains in fixture-result.json. Independent world/status queries verify the fixture was gone and PX4 was landed/disarmed; this run supports the completed motion and health observation, but is not relabeled as an unqualified successful collector run.

historical_quality_trigger.current_reproduction: Not reproduced in #085 or #086 under the exact same runtime contract and drift support profile. #086 approached the 1.0 health limit at 0.9730 without crossing it.
historical_quality_trigger.interpretation: Do not call the historical event a false alarm or claim its cause was fixed. The original trigger-frame telemetry/input/prior alignment was not captured. Carry this uncertainty into N10 applicability and regression decisions.

historical_timing_observations.current_repeat_interpretation: The two controlled normal support-motion observations #085/#086 had optimized-odometry maximum receipt gaps below 0.300 s. The old isolated receipt-age events were not root-caused; do not generalize these two runs to other load profiles.

current_sensor_fault_injection.method: The launch-time bridge maps Gazebo stereo images to /fault/input; the existing source-stamp relay forwards normal frames, drops one bounded window, then resumes. The /clock bridge is continuous and was not restarted.

visual_quality_fault_evidence.historical_result: Two independent black-image injections preserved advancing stamps, produced zero-feature VINS telemetry, and locked the adapter with input_features_insufficient.
visual_quality_fault_evidence.version_limit: The historical black-image injection predates the current VINS binary. Patches 0015-0019 are documented as observer/diagnostic additions that do not alter the feature pipeline, but this is not an exact current-binary black-image rerun. Current-binary input-stale behavior is independently verified by #088.

invalid_attempts.reason: The test replaced the live sensor bridge. Health locked on clock_stalled at source/status time 46.716 s before the scheduled stereo drop began at 66.200 s; it cannot qualify the left/right stale response.
invalid_attempts.lesson: Use the launch-time bridge override so /clock has a single continuous publisher throughout the fault test.

changes: The stream observer now records only the latest left/right/IMU input stamp per telemetry event; interval distributions remain in the summary. The analyzer reads both compact and legacy event formats.
An optional sensor_bridge_config launch argument and D435I_SENSOR_BRIDGE_CONFIG runtime input allow a run-local Gazebo bridge YAML. Unset behavior retains the original default bridge.
No localization-health algorithm, threshold, latch, or PX4 control behavior was changed.
